note: Primitive Forest Service campground at 15-acre McCormack Lake, a non-motorized lake (electric trolling motors only) south of Winona, reached by Forest Road 3155, which the Forest Service calls drivable in any vehicle. Sites are in woods along the road on the lake's west side; tables, fire rings and lantern posts, with the vault toilet at the picnic area. Pack in, pack out. A trail from the day-use area joins the Ozark Trail's Eleven Point River section. The lake has been drawn down for repairs since September 2025; short closures are possible while heavy equipment works. --Claude
summary: Confirmed free, 6 sites, vault toilet, no water; season now year-round (FS 'January - December'). WATERFRONT DOWN lakeview -> not waterfront (unconfirmed). Pin moves ~1.1 km out of the woods to the west-shore campsites. Phone 573-996-2153 to add.
flags: PIN (move ~1.1 km): stored 36.8297,-91.3617 is in unbroken forest ~1 km NW of the lake. The FS point 36.822513,-91.351175 is the day-use lot and picnic area at the lake head (the FS bans overnight camping in day-use areas). Imagery shows a trailer and truck in a wooded clearing beside the road on the west shore at 36.8216,-91.3521 - move the pin there. The six sites themselves are not visible under the canopy and no map numbers them.

WATERFRONT DOWN (lakeview -> not waterfront): the only campsite seen (the occupied clearing) is ~35 m from the water across a wooded bank, with no open apron, so not lakefront. No page or photo shows a lake view from the sites, and in leaf-on season the bank trees would screen it; the other five sites are unlocated. Went down because the view is unconfirmed.

RIG FIT: FS 'Forest Road 3155 ... The lake is about 2 miles down this road, which is drivable in any vehicle'; the imagery shows a travel trailer with a pickup at the west-shore clearing. No length limit published. A 23-ft rig should fit; nothing confirms it per site.
